title: PhD Position in Accounting
about: The University of Zurich's accounting group seeks doctoral candidates starting August 2027. Applicants need a master's in accounting, finance, economics, statistics or a related quantitative field. Applications and two recommendation letters are due 15 January 2027.
requirements: Master's degree in accounting, finance, economics, statistics or a related quantitative field (completion by August 2027 acceptable)

upskill.name: AI for Accounting & Financial Operations
why: Requirement "Master's degree in accounting, finance, economics, statistics or a related quantitative field" → objective "Use AI to streamline invoice processing, expense management, reconciliations, transaction classification, and other repetitive accounting and financial operations."
Field "Accounting" → objective "Design human-in-the-loop workflows that maintain accuracy, traceability, approval requirements, segregation of duties, and appropriate financial controls."
